changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE abac_policy_items ADD COLUMN scope_id BIGINT NULL;

changeSet.author: [Z4999972] Aditya Murda Nugraha
changeSet.sql: UPDATE abac_policy_items api INNER JOIN abac_policies ap ON api.policy_id = ap.policy_id INNER JOIN scopes s ON api.scope = s.scope_key AND s.project_id = ap.project_id AND s.access_control_model = 'ABAC' AND s.is_deleted = false SET api.scope_id = s.scope_id WHERE api.scope IS NOT NULL;
